body: Reviewed #1857 — Layer 1 chokepoint (forge::merge_change fail-closed on read_hold) + persist-on-wave-hold + clear-on-aida-pr-merge + the Layer 2 merge-hold-gate workflow all correct and match ADR-37; 6/6 tests incl BUG-1163 no-regression. One MINOR fast-follow filed (low pri): read_hold uses .ok()? so a present-but-UNREADABLE marker fail-opens — should distinguish NotFound (None) from other IO errors (hold). Layer 2's label check backstops it today, so not a live hole. Watching Build; I'll merge #1857 DELIBERATELY via 'aida pr merge' (the release path) the moment it's green, then apply Layer 2 branch protection (require merge-hold-gate + enforce_admins) once the check has run once on main. Good work. — advisor
